$ agenthub move-instance --to <TMP>/new --apply    # config invalid
[exit 1]
--- stdout
copy <TMP>/config/hub.json → <TMP>/new/config/hub.json
copy <TMP>/data/todo.md → <TMP>/new/data/todo.md

the config in the new layout is invalid; not writing <TMP>/fakehub/.hub-home (the copies are in <TMP>/new; delete them and start over)
